program.name: Swift Agent — Persistence & Observability Reliability
program.description: Make database evolution and run/trace observability production-safe: migration status/drift detection with a CI guard, a rollback + reconciliation runbook, a run-history/metrics API over persisted spans, trace-persistence hardening, and migration + observability integration tests.

successCriteria.description: migrate status accurately reports applied and pending migrations by comparing the journal against the database's migration bookkeeping.
The drift check exits non-zero for a database whose live schema diverges from the journal baseline and zero for a clean match.
migrate refuses to apply when drift is detected, leaving the database unmodified.
CI fails the build when schema drift is present.
The deployed ECS migration task runs the same migrator and status gate as local and CI.
A documented runbook covers forward-fix rollback, snapshot/restore, and deployed-drift reconciliation, validated against a worked forward-fix example.
GET /v1/runs/:runId/metrics returns token usage, latency, and model/tool span counts derived from the run's persisted trace and spans, under workspace-ownership enforcement.
A run's model, tool, and error spans are persisted and reflected in both the trace-retrieval and metrics responses.
Trace-write failures are surfaced through structured logging with run/trace identifiers, and span metadata/error payloads are bounded before persistence.
Migration integration tests cover baseline application from empty, ordered incremental application, idempotent re-run, and drift detection against an injected divergence.
Observability integration tests cover model/tool/error span persistence, metrics-endpoint roll-ups, and failure-path trace finalization.
Monorepo type-checking, linting, unit tests, and runtime integration tests pass.

packages.name: @swiftagent/db
packages.description: Migration status reporter, schema drift detection, and migrate preflight guard layered on the existing greenfield baseline + migrator.

packages.name: @swiftagent/observability
packages.description: deriveRunMetrics surfaced for the metrics API; bounded span metadata/error payloads.

packages.name: @swiftagent/api
packages.description: GET /v1/runs/:runId/metrics route + metrics assembly over persisted trace/spans and run token usage.

packages.name: @swiftagent/runtime
packages.description: Structured logging of best-effort trace-write failures; token metadata on model spans so metrics roll-ups are populated.

packages.name: apps/server
packages.description: Wire the metrics route/service and a structured logger into the container and route registration.

successCriteriaNotes: core-runtime-completion already delivered the greenfield migration baseline, tracer wiring into the loop, atomic span persistence, and trace-retrieval APIs; this program hardens the operational edges only.

outOfScope: Down/reverse migration commands (rollback is forward-fix + restore)
Automated reconciliation of a drifted deployed schema
New trace or span schema fields
Streaming or push delivery of metrics
Changes to the runtime loop control flow, providers, or executor resolution
Durable execution / run recovery across restarts
